gloss: navigation system; car nav; GPS navigation

definitions.gloss: navigation system; car nav; GPS navigation
definitions.explanation: An abbreviated form of ナビゲーション (navigation). Refers primarily to car navigation systems (カーナビ), but also used more broadly for any GPS or map-based navigation on smartphones and other devices.

examples.japanese: ナビに{住所|じゅうしょ}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I entered the address into the navigation system.

examples.japanese: ナビの{案内|あんない}に{従|したが}って{走|はし}った。
examples.english: I drove following the navigation's directions.

examples.japanese: ナビが{古|ふる}くて、{新|あたら}しい{道|みち}が{表示|ひょうじ}されなかった。
examples.english: The nav system was outdated and didn't show the new road.

examples.japanese: {知|し}らない{土地|とち}ではスマホのナビがないと{不安|ふあん}だ。
examples.english: In an unfamiliar place, I feel uneasy without my phone's navigation.

notes:
An abbreviation of ナビゲーション (navigation), itself from English. In Japanese, ナビ most commonly refers to an in-car GPS navigation device (カーナビ), which has been standard equipment in Japanese cars for decades. Japan was an early adopter of car navigation technology, and the word became part of everyday vocabulary.

More recently, ナビ also covers smartphone navigation apps like Google Maps. The word is used both as a standalone noun and as part of compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カーナビ: car navigation system
- ナビを{設定|せってい}する: to set the navigation
- ナビに{従|したが}う: to follow the nav
- ナビの{案内|あんない}: navigation directions/guidance
- ナビを{使|つか}う: to use the nav

SIMILAR WORDS:
- カーナビ: car navigation — the full compound; essentially the same as ナビ in driving contexts
- {地図|ちず}アプリ: map app — the smartphone equivalent, though ナビ is also used for phone navigation
- GPS: GPS — the underlying satellite technology; ナビ refers to the user-facing system/device
